entries.name: author-popcandy-component
entries.description: Use when adding or materially changing a public Unpopping Candy or social component, including its API, metadata, stories, tests, documentation, and release record.

entries.name: build-popcandy-interface
entries.description: Use when building a new page, workflow, block, or application shell with Unpopping Candy from a functional requirement or visual reference.

entries.name: connect-popcandy-figma
entries.description: Use when mapping Unpopping Candy components to Figma Code Connect, validating Figma component properties, or preparing Code Connect publication.

entries.name: migrate-to-popcandy
entries.description: Use when replacing an existing React UI library, custom component set, or copied markup with Unpopping Candy while preserving application behavior.

entries.name: popcandy-ui
entries.description: Use whenever a task creates, changes, reviews, or migrates a React interface that should use Unpopping Candy components, tokens, patterns, or templates.

entries.name: review-popcandy-interface
entries.description: Use when reviewing generated or hand-written React UI for Unpopping Candy component reuse, design-token compliance, state completeness, accessibility, and product-pattern correctness.
